description: Use when an agent needs an illustration at a size it chooses: FLUX.2 klein from a text prompt, with your own width and height (256-1536). If klein is slow, FLUX.1 [schnell] answers instead at 1024x1024, and the response says which model drew it. A seed is passed through but does not guarantee the same image twice. Returns a hosted image URL valid for 24 hours; add inline=true to also get the base64. You are only charged if the image is delivered. No API key, no account. $0.01 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

height.description: Height in pixels, a multiple of 8 between 256 and 1536. Default 1024.

inline.description: Also return the image as base64. Default false.

prompt.description: What to draw, up to 2048 characters. English works best.

seed.description: Passed to the model; it does not guarantee the same image twice.

width.description: Width in pixels, a multiple of 8 between 256 and 1536. Default 1024.

name: ai_image_styled
title: Illustration from text, any size (FLUX.2 klein)
